validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml"
       xmlns:event="https://github.com/stateforward/scxml.rs/namespaces/event"
       version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="ordering">
  <state id="ordering">
    <invoke id="order" src="invoked/event011-child.scx"/>
    <transition event="order.ready"
                event:schema='{"type":"object","properties":{"count":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["count"]}'>
      <send event="order.place" target="#_order"><content>{"quantity": "two"}</content></send>
    </transition>
    <transition event="done.invoke.order" target="done"/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `invoked/event011-child.scx` sends `order.ready` to `#_parent` with data a transition here handling it does not accept

secondary.message: ... which fails the schema of this transition

notes: a transition's `event:schema` describes the `_event.data` it handles; the invoked document's `<send target="#_parent">` creates data this transition's event descriptor matches but its schema rejects (events between sessions are not checked at run time yet: the transition is still taken)
diagnostics.help: make the two documents' schemas agree, or change the data the invoked document sends

diagnostics.message: `<send>` sends `order.place` to the session of `invoked/event011-child.scx` with data a transition there handling it does not accept

primary.message: its literal data, `{"quantity":"two"}`, fails the schema of a transition of `invoked/event011-child.scx` handling `order.place`

notes: a transition's `event:schema` describes the `_event.data` it handles; a transition of the invoked document matches this event but its schema rejects this data (events between sessions are not checked at run time yet: the transition is still taken)
diagnostics.help: make the two documents' schemas agree, or change the data
